reason: This plugin is a user-facing DSH media utility that augments the web GUI with customizable event sounds: users configure a draggable floating control, assign sounds to conversation events, manage a local sound library, and optionally generate speech via an external AI voice API; evidence is directly documented in the README and package wiring.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH Web GUI 的声音工具，提供可视化设置来为会话事件绑定提示音、管理本地音频库，并可通过外部 AI 语音服务生成并加入角色语音。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web GUI media utility that lets users configure event-linked sounds through a visual control panel, manage a local audio library, and optionally generate and add AI voices via an external TTS service.

capabilities: exposes host-side static routes for config and audio serving
optional external TTS integration for AI voice generation

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a Sound Lab with a floating ball UI, per-event sound assignment (session end/options/permission/stop), and a web GUI settings dialog.
README documents a local sound library in the plugin sounds/ folder with refresh, upload/drag-drop, delete, and restore flows, implying local file read/write operations.
README describes a host endpoint set (/dsh-sounds-control) for list/config/audio/TTS and client-side playback logic, indicating networked interaction between host and browser halves.
README includes an AI Voice dialog requiring Alibaba Cloud Bailian API key and cloned voice ID to generate custom speech, showing optional external service usage.
package.json defines the plugin dual-side wiring via dsh.bundle.patch and web client injection, confirming plugin execution in both host (Node) and web client environments.

capabilities: exposes host-side static routes for config and audio serving
optional external TTS integration for AI voice generation
